followUps: version-line repeats every merge (4 package.json files, also in v0.1.10) but cannot move: apps/server reads its package.json version at runtime (cli/*, serverVersion drives ServerUpdateAction's release-track check). Instead, have the merge step resolve it mechanically: a fork-only merge driver script (scripts/) registered per clone in .git/info/attributes for **/package.json that runs git merge-file and then restores the fork's version line. Keep it out of the committed .gitattributes, which is upstream's file.

apps/web/src/components/settings/settingsSearch.ts is a repeat (v0.1.10, top hotFile, 17 fork lines). Move the two plugin SETTINGS_SEARCH_ITEMS entries into an as-const array in a fork-only apps/web/src/components/plugins/pluginSettingsSearch.ts (type-only import of SettingsSearchItem, no cycle) and spread it as the last element of SETTINGS_SEARCH_ITEMS in one line. The four Record<SettingsPath, ...>/union/nav-group entries must stay inline because the Records are exhaustive over SettingsPath, but put each at the end of its structure rather than alphabetically among upstream's lines, where they collided this time.

The row's `${n} new` value gets translated in the move.

merges.notes: This merge supersedes PR #13 (https://github.com/marcelocantos/t3code/pull/13, the v0.1.12 merge), because v0.1.13 contains v0.1.12; #13 and its ledger entry do not land on main, so the report's priorMerges omit v0.1.12, in which 24 of these 26 files also conflicted (all but ThreadRouteScreen.tsx and ThreadDetailsCard.tsx). Each conflicted file was resolved by replaying #13's resolved file (cfb9b8afb6) with git merge-file against v0.1.12 and v0.1.13, which carried #13's resolution plus upstream's v0.1.12 to v0.1.13 delta; 9 files replayed cleanly and 17 were finished by hand (the 4 version lines, app.config.ts, ThreadRouteScreen.tsx, ThreadDetailsCard.tsx and the 10 web catalogs). Follow-up 69b8dc18ab is a cherry-pick of #13's b8c03dfa7c and is still needed: v0.1.13's layerRuntimeCoreDependenciesBase pipe already has 20 steps, the merge made 21, and the commit moves the fork's PanelPlugins layer into the end of the mergeAll list, giving 20. Reviewed by a second agent: the fork's diff against v0.1.13 matches its diff against the merge base in every file except the expected ones (version lines, catalog order, re-indented ThreadRouteScreen.tsx code, merged selectors, upstream-deleted devProxy set); the merge's only change outside the conflicted files is the mobile catalogs' key order from i18n:generate. One defect: the replay covered only conflicted files, so #13's single non-conflicted edit, { redactedParams: ["*"] } on the gateway route in apps/server/src/plugins/PluginGatewayHttp.ts, was not carried, and with upstream's path-based isSignedUrlRequest gone, gateway spans record the panel's bearer token in the path. The follow-up fix(server) commit that redacts the gateway path token restores it.
followUps: Replays of a superseded merge PR must also diff its non-conflicted files (git diff <merge-tree of the PR's parents> <PR merge commit>) and carry those edits; this merge lost #13's gateway redaction that way (restored by the follow-up fix(server) commit).
